record.question: Which IQ range is indicative of Intellectual Disability?
record.explanation: Answer C: Below 70. Intellectual disability requires deficits in intellectual and adaptive functioning with onset during development; IQ around 70 or below may support diagnosis but is not sufficient alone. Source/context note: Modern diagnosis is not based solely on an IQ cutoff. Reference: https://www.aaidd.org/intellectual-disability/definition. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
